title: Korean man's ayahuasca sessions in Peru turn into alien abduction by an 'alien scientist'

tellings.quote: that. He got a full-blown alien experience. He he was taken by this what he described as the alien scientist

plain: In 2024 a Korean man drinking ayahuasca in Peru had what he called a full-blown alien experience. Ayahuasca is a psychedelic brew used in Amazon ceremonies. During it, he said, he was taken away by a being he described as "the alien scientist." The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, who studies the psychedelic DMT, tells Michels what the man told him, as an example of how these substances can seem to open contact with alien beings.
